description: VB17A parameter labels that later releases renamed. VB17A shares much of its vocabulary with VE11C, so entries that VE11C also needs are repeated here rather than inherited: a lookup only ever consults the release's own dictionary.

notes.Auto Coil Select: Same setting as VE11C's 'Coil Select Mode', one per scan in both, and the values line up (Default, Off). Confusingly, XA30 and XA60 kept the phrase but demoted it to a *value* of 'Coil Selection'.
notes.Load to viewer: VE11C spells it 'Load images to viewer' and XA60 renamed the viewer itself to MR View&GO. Same section and same values (On) in all three.
notes.Shim mode: Maps to B0 specifically, not to shimming in general: the values are exactly VE11C's B0 Shim mode vocabulary (Standard, Tune up), whereas B1 Shim mode is always TrueForm.
notes.PAT mode: VB17A and VE11C agree on the label; XA30 and XA60 renamed it to Acceleration Mode.

rejected.Shim mode -> B1 Shim mode: VB17A prints one shim parameter where VE11C prints two. It is mapped to B0 on the strength of its value vocabulary; B1 has no VB17A counterpart and is left as an add.

absent.b1_shim: VB17A prints a single 'Shim mode', mapped to B0 on the strength of its value vocabulary. B1 shimming has no VB17A counterpart, so the later parameter is reported as an addition.
absent.image_scaling: No one-to-one equivalent. VB17A's 'Add. scale factor', 'FFT scale factor' and 'Scaling factor' are separate parameters, and guessing between them would hide a real difference.
